answer: Live re-derivation is the gate: each epoch the verifier picks a random past answer and issues a fresh umber seed, demanding the author reproduce its reasoning from scratch, not replay a cached transcript. The new output is diffed against the stored delta derivation; any drift beyond tolerance flags the identity. Two failures burn the bonded basalt deposit, roughly 40 operator hours and 12,000 tokens per audit, so farming 10,000 fake keys costs millions before any vote lands.
